defect: GetPropertyIdentifierLocation casts the declaring syntax to PropertyDeclarationSyntax instead of testing the type, so a property declared by a record's positional parameter throws InvalidCastException.
why: The helper exists to avoid a crash on unusual declarations; the hard cast brings back a crash for properties whose syntax is a parameter, which breaks F1 and F2 for record structs declared in source.
writtenBy: engine lane (Miska), drafted by an isolated Claude Sonnet builder that never saw prompts, pipeline or review output
